title: "Movie Analysis"
author: "Lizzie"
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
movies <- read_csv("data/movies.csv")
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
movies_clean <- movies |>
  separate_longer_delim(genre, delim = ",") |>
  mutate(genre = str_trim(genre))
```

```{r}
movies |>
  ggplot(aes(x = tomatoMeter)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 5, na.rm = TRUE) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Tomatometer Scores",
    subtitle = paste(nrow(movies), "films"),
    x = "Tomatometer Score",
    y = "Count"
  )
```

```{r}
movies_gap <- movies_clean |>
  filter(tomatoMeter != 0, audienceScore != 0) |>
  mutate(gap = tomatoMeter - audienceScore)

movies_summary <- movies_gap |>
  group_by(genre) |>
  summarise(
    mean_gap = mean(gap, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(n >= 100) |>
  arrange(mean_gap)
```

```{r}
movies_summary |>
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(genre, mean_gap), y = mean_gap)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Average Critic-Audience Score Gap by Genre",
    subtitle = "Genres with at least 100 films",
    x = "Genre",
    y = "Mean gap (Tomatometer minus audience score)"
  )
```

```{r}
spiderman_titles <- c(
  "Spider-Man",
  "Spider-Man 2",
  "Spider-Man 3",
  "The Amazing Spider-Man",
  "The Amazing Spider-Man 2",
  "Spider-Man: Homecoming",
  "Spider-Man: Far From Home",
  "Spider-Man: No Way Home"
)

spiderman <- movies |>
  filter(title %in% spiderman_titles) |>
  mutate(actor = case_when(
    title %in% c("Spider-Man", "Spider-Man 2", "Spider-Man 3") ~ "Tobey Maguire",
    title %in% c("The Amazing Spider-Man", "The Amazing Spider-Man 2") ~ "Andrew Garfield",
    str_detect(title, ":") ~ "Tom Holland"
  )) |>
  arrange(releaseDateTheaters)

spiderman |>
  mutate(film_order = row_number()) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(tomatoMeter, audienceScore),
    names_to = "score_type",
    values_to = "score"
  ) |>
  mutate(score_type = recode(
    score_type,
    tomatoMeter = "Tomatometer",
    audienceScore = "Audience"
  )) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = film_order, y = score, color = score_type, group = score_type)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq_len(nrow(spiderman)), labels = spiderman$title) +
  labs(
    title = "Audience Scores Often Trail Critics Across Spider-Man Films",
    subtitle = "Tomatometer and audience score by release order",
    x = "Film",
    y = "Score",
    color = "Score"
  ) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```
